name: Electric blankets and heating pads

comps.spec: Long flexible heating wire, about 50–200W at mains voltage; 12V car blankets draw about 40–60W straight from a battery
comps.loc: Sewn through the blanket in channels

comps.spec: Fleece or polyester blanket — still warm with the power off
Triac or relay switching the heat

notes: A 12V blanket warms a person for a fraction of the power a space heater uses on the whole room.

sources.title: Open Repair Alliance, Open Repair Data v0.3 (community repair events, 2012 to July 2026; CC BY-SA 4.0): 1,028 repairs recorded as Small home electrical (electric blanket subset)
